title: BitFinca
tagline: BitFinca is a blockchain-based lending platform that allows anyone to microinvest in ventures that matter, with no minimum investment.
description:
BitFinca is a blockchain-based lending platform that allows anyone to microinvest in ventures that matter, with no minimum investment. The platform is built on the Ethereum blockchain and smart contracts, powered by Multibaas and AAVE, making sure that it is transparent, efficient, and secure. Through our lending and investment products, BitFinca aims to offer micro-investment opportunities for hundreds of decentralized projects and businesses.

Bitfinca provides the financial services of microfinance in a digital world, making them accessible to everyone, no matter their economic status or geographical location. We provide micro-loans and crowdfund loans for entrepreneurs who need capital to grow their businesses. Our goal is to provide financial services to people who need them, in a safe and trustful way – a better world needs a better financial system. We are a microfinance solution for the community.
how_its_made:
The platform is built on the Ethereum blockchain and smart contracts, powered by Multibaas and AAVE, making sure that it is transparent, efficient, and secure.

Front-end was built with vue.js and vuetify. The backend is powered by smart contracts in Solidity, Multibaas and AAVE. Metamask was used to connect the front-end to web3 and interact with the smart contracts.
